question: Which element was proposed by Glenn T Seaborg in 1955 through the bombardment of a minute amount of a rare, radioactive isotope of Einsteinium with α-particles in a 60-inch cyclotron?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mendelevium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Glenn T. Seaborg and his team bombarded a minute amount of a rare, radioactive isotope of Einsteinium with α-particles in a 60-inch cyclotron in 1955.
 
• This led to the discovery of the element Mendelevium.
 
• Mendelevium is a synthetic element with the symbol Md and atomic number 101.
 
• It is a member of the Actinide series and named after Dmitri Mendeleev.
 
• Dmitri Mendeleev is known as the father of the periodic table of chemical elements.
 
• Mendelevium was the ninth transuranic element to be synthesized.
 
• It was first synthesized by bombarding einsteinium-253 with alpha particles. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lawrencium**

 
 
• Lawrencium is a synthetic chemical element with the symbol Lr and atomic number 103.
 
• It is named after Ernest O. Lawrence, the inventor of the cyclotron, a device that was used to discover many artificial radioactive elements.
 
• It has no stable isotopes.
 
• A half-life of 3.6 hours for lawrencium-262, has been reported, but this has not yet been confirmed.
 
 
 
• **Nobelium**
 
 
• Nobelium is a synthetic chemical element with the symbol No and atomic number 102.
 
• It is named in honor of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite and benefactor of science.
 
• It is a radioactive, primarily synthetic element that can be created in particle accelerators, though it was erroneously reported as a naturally occurring element in the early 20th century.
 
 
 
• **Neptunium**
 
 
• Neptunium is a chemical element with the symbol Np and atomic number 93.
 
• It is a radioactive actinide metal, which was the first transuranium element to be synthesized.
 
• The isotope neptunium-237 is a by-product of nuclear reactors and plutonium production, and it is the most long-lived isotope of neptunium, with a half-life of 2.14 million years.
